videos.desc: At night the camera looks at the closed side window of a dark red pickup truck. The glass is completely fogged up, with only vague golden shapes moving behind it. The window clears and shows two golden retrievers in the cab, both wearing baseball caps, one with a paw up on the door, as pale smoke drifts out around them. They sit there staring out. Then the truck pulls away and speeds off down a dark road.
videos.said: You know why I pulled you over? I don't know. But something's wrong with the stop sign. It won't turn green. Step out of the vehicle. Dispatch, I got a vehicle fleeing.

videos.desc: A young man in a green jacket films himself riding an old city bike through Amsterdam. He pedals over a brick street lined with narrow gabled houses and parked bikes, then along a canal with boats moored under bare trees, then past a brick building and in through a wide entrance. Inside he rides down the aisle of an enormous multi-storey bicycle park, racks of bikes stacked to the ceiling on both sides, and points up at them.

A man in a red jacket films himself from the handlebars as he rides. First he sits on his bike on a sandy track between green fields, looking up at a level-crossing sign against a blue sky. Then he is stopped at the edge of a village road, one hand on the handlebar, watching cars go past a traffic light. Finally he is at a big city junction under tram wires, with traffic lights, cars turning and a crowd of people waiting on the far pavement, his mouth open in surprise.

A road cyclist in a teal kit and a white helmet rides down a narrow tarmac road that winds through green tropical hills. The camera holds on him from the front as he drives on the pedals, then swings to the side as he tucks low over the handlebars; behind him the road curves away with a crash barrier along its edge. He leans hard through a bend, then straightens up on a long descent with mountains and cloud filling the horizon.

A point-of-view shot from inside an open-topped vintage car: two tanned hands hold the thin black steering wheel while the car rolls down a narrow cobbled village street between whitewashed houses with people walking ahead. The road opens onto a coastal highway with the blue sea and cliffs on the left, and the wheel turns as the car follows the bends. The camera then shows the driver herself, a woman in a colourful shirt and sunglasses, one hand on the wheel, looking out at the ocean as she drives along the clifftop road.

A sequence of drivers seen from inside their vehicles. A man in a suit holds the steering wheel of a saloon car crawling through city traffic, with rows of cars and brake lights ahead and skyscrapers above. A woman smiles at the wheel of a white box van stopped at a red traffic light in a suburban street, then pulls away as the light turns green. A couple sit in a blue convertible parked above the ocean, and a bearded man in a checked shirt drives a car along a winding forest road at sunset with his window down.

A young man in a yellow raincoat leans over the varnished wooden rail of a small boat, an orange life ring hanging beside him. The water is grey-green and snow-covered mountains stand on the far shore. A dark shape rises under the surface and a barnacled humpback whale lifts its head out of the water alongside the hull. The whale slips back down and leaves a wide swirl of white foam turning on the water next to the boat.

An indoor trampoline park with a huge pit of coloured foam cubes. A man in orange shorts lies half buried in the cubes, laughing. Others run to the edge and drop off it, dropping through the air into the pit and disappearing under the blocks. More people leap in one after another, landing on their backs and sides among the foam, until several of them are lying in the pit surrounded by scattered cubes.

Two freedivers in black wetsuits and long fins move through clear blue open water along a thin vertical line. One is far below in the dark blue, the other kicks upward towards the bright surface, and by the end both are near the top with sunlight breaking through the water above them.

A montage of one young man shifting heavy things. He leans into the back of a small silver car on a suburban street and shoves it along the kerb. Next he is behind a supermarket trolley in a car park, driving it forward across the tarmac. Then he stands behind a child on a playground swing and sends him forward. In a warehouse he braces his shoulder against a huge wooden crate and tips it along the floor, and finally a group of friends put their hands on a giant stone ball on a grassy hill and roll it over the grass.

Outside a suburban house a woman in work gloves carries a cardboard box down the drive past a wall of stacked boxes, then a tower of five boxes. Behind her a large white box truck stands open with a ramp down; she and two other movers slide boxes and a brown leather sofa up the ramp into the truck's cargo hold, which is already packed with boxes.

A woman braces her hands against the back of a small silver car and shoves it along the street. The shot widens and a line of people is pushing the back of a long city bus, number 230, with its destination sign lit, along the road; then a group pushes the back of a lorry trailer, and finally a whole row of people leans into an enormous round boulder in the road.

In a school sports hall a teenage boy in a grey shirt stands motionless on the centre line of the basketball court; the camera pulls back and more and more students appear standing in the same frozen pose, until an aerial view shows the whole hall filled with rows of unmoving students.

A low camera close to the boards shows two two-wheeled pedal vehicles rolling side by side along a wooden seaside pier, a young man and a young woman pedalling and laughing above them. They hold the camera at arm's length for a selfie with the beach and palm trees behind. They get off, and on the pier she spins and he catches her; they hold each other by the railing, then stand together grinning at the camera with the sun setting over the sea.

A young man in a light blue shirt and dark tie sits in the driver's seat of a city bus at a depot, both hands on the large black steering wheel. He turns the wheel as the bus rolls out; a low shot from behind the wheel shows the dashboard and the road ahead. Back inside, passengers sit in blue seats behind him while he keeps one hand on the wheel and presses a red button on the console, smiling and speaking towards the door.

On an alpine trail below snowy peaks a woman in a red jacket holds an open map, raises her arm and points along the path, and a line of hikers with poles and backpacks walks behind her. She steps first across a stream on stones while the group waits on the bank and watches her line. Then a women's rowing four cuts across a turquoise lake, the woman in the bow setting the stroke and finally punching a fist into the air.

A military band in black ceremonial uniforms with red-striped trousers and peaked caps moves down a city street in formation, legs swinging up high in unison and white-gloved arms swinging, brass instruments raised. An officer with a sword strides at the front. Behind steel barriers a dense crowd films and waves Indian flags. The shot then cuts to a wide view down a flag-lined avenue where a huge column of uniformed ranks stretches into the distance, watched by a grandfather holding a child in the foreground.

A young man in a black leather jacket and jeans rides a small green two-wheeler through a sunny town, sitting up at the handlebars with the round headlight in front of him. He then stands astride a big black machine at a lookout above the sea. In the last part the camera rides with a whole group of riders in helmets and leather jackets as they roll down a coastal road above blue water.

A young woman in a mustard beanie climbs the steps into a train while a member of staff helps lift her hard-shell suitcase; another train and travellers with luggage are on the platform behind her. Inside, she walks down the narrow carriage corridor holding her ticket, heaves the suitcase onto the overhead rack, then sits by the window and watches the platform and rails slide past as the train pulls away.

A young man in an orange hooded jacket with a bag strapped across his chest walks quickly along a brick pavement in a Dutch city, past shoppers and parked bicycles. He steps off the kerb and crosses a wide zebra crossing while the light shows red for cars, then hurries down a narrow lane lined with flower stalls full of tulips and bunches in buckets. He comes out on a big paved square where a long blue and white electric train runs along rails in the street right behind him, with cyclists passing in front of it. He looks down at his wrist as he keeps walking with the tram still rolling past behind him.

A young man with a camera round his neck stands on a wooden jetty in a container port. A small motorboat passes behind him while gantry cranes and stacks of steel shipping containers fill the far bank. He raises a pair of binoculars and watches a green ship loaded with containers glide past, then the white bow of an enormous cruise ship slides in right beside the jetty and he tips his head further and further back, open-mouthed, as its decks pass above him.

A traffic policeman in a khaki uniform and peaked cap stands on the centre line of a busy Indian street. He raises a white-gloved palm towards the oncoming traffic and the scooters, motorbikes and cars slow and come to a halt in front of him. A city bus rolls up and stops right behind him, and he then stretches both arms out sideways to hold the two lanes still.

A selfie-stick POV of a young woman riding a road bike at speed on a mountain road. She rushes out of a dark tunnel into green forest, keeps pedalling along the open road, races through a white-tiled underpass, then through a lit road tunnel where a car passes her, and finally approaches another arched tunnel mouth. The road, walls and trees stream past her the whole time while she grins into the camera.

Seen from the front seat of a car, a laughing young man in a light blue t-shirt and beige trousers sits in the back while a golden retriever stands on the back seat and licks his face. The dog then turns, steps across the canvas bags and a rolled mat towards the front, and finally sits down beside him with its tongue out as he hugs it. A hand in a rust sleeve rests on the front headrest, a water bottle lies on the floor, and pine trees show through the windows.

Inside the cab of a steam locomotive, a smiling young man in blue overalls, a flat cap and a red neckerchief leans out of the side opening, holding a handle, as steam streams past. He turns back in, reaches down to a brass lever, then leans out again with a grin. Around him are brass gauges, copper pipes, valves and an open firebox glowing orange, with a brass wheel in the foreground. Outside are green hills and a curved stone viaduct, with smoke drifting overhead.

On a city street at dusk after rain, a laughing young woman with curly hair, a camel coat and white trainers leaps through the air towards the open door of a red bus, holding a stack of white gift boxes above her head, while her silk scarf falls into a puddle. She lands inside the bus, passengers wave and clap at the windows, a pigeon flaps up, and the doors close. The bus then drives away from the glass shelter, leaving the scarf lying on the wet pavement.

A snowy mountain road under a cloudy sky. A young woman in a red puffer jacket and snow boots throws her fist in the air, shouts with joy and jumps next to a small white car with a red L sign on its roof, then leans in at the driver's window. Inside, a young man with glasses smiles from the driver's seat and holds up a clipboard with a big green tick. A man in an orange vest watches from a truck window, an orange snowplough waits behind, and a line of cars comes down the road.

A pit stop on a race track at dusk. A blue single-seat race car stands on a jack in the pit lane while a crew in blue overalls works on it at top speed. A young woman in a white top throws an old tyre through the air, picks up a new wheel and pushes it onto the front of the car as the view moves in close. A young man crouches at another wheel, and a crew member behind the car holds up a round sign. Air hoses hang from a metal boom, and an empty grandstand stands in the distance.

A wooden boardwalk crossing the dunes towards a beach on a sunny evening. The boardwalk simply stops, its end dropping into the soft white sand. A young man in an open blue shirt and white shorts flies off the end of it into the air, his skateboard tipping into the sand and throwing up a puff of sand, and he lands and falls back to sit in the sand. Behind him a young blonde woman rides a skateboard along the boardwalk, and friends walk up with a surfboard and a cool box.

A narrow cobbled lane between old honey-coloured stone cottages with climbing roses. A small vintage green car is so close to the stone wall that a young man in a white T-shirt and navy trousers is squeezed into the tiny gap between the car and the wall, pressing his hand against the stones and shouting to the driver. Inside, a young woman covers her mouth with her hand in shock. A tabby cat walks along the top of the wall towards him, and flower boxes and a street lantern hang on the houses.

A narrow road through an alpine village on a sunny summer day, with wooden chalets, green meadows and snow-capped mountains under a blue sky. A young woman in a blue cycling jersey and helmet rides a road bike along the road towards the viewer, going by an old red tractor pulling a trailer piled high with hay, and moves ahead of it with a smile. A young man drives the tractor. A brown cow grazes in a field beside a stone wall on the left.

A narrow city street at night in the rain, lit by glowing paper lanterns and shop signs. A giant tortoise plods across a wet zebra crossing, lifting one heavy foot after the other and slowly moving forward over the puddles. Right behind it a dark green classic sports car waits with its headlights on. Power lines hang overhead, a small tree stands in a lit shop window, and a fallen maple leaf lies on the wet road in front.
